title: Logos 22 opening: day and hour unknown (Mk 13 / Mt 24)
english: Twenty-second discourse. On “of that day and hour no one knows, not even the Son, but the Father alone.”
Ignorance language is read without sundering the Son’s essence from the Father who made ages and times.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
